subject: SIG follow-up: final artifacts and delivery schedule
messages:
From: Samantha Yoo <samantha.yoo@brightwellhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procure@brightwellhealth.com
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 10:24:00 -0800
Subject: SIG follow-up: final artifacts and delivery schedule

Marcus —

Thanks for the SIG questionnaire submission last week. Procurement needs a few final artifacts to close our vendor evaluation:

- SOC 2 Type II (most recent report or draft acceptable)
- Pen test executive summary (redacted is fine)
- ISO statements (scope and cert status)
- A short security overview deck we can share with our InfoSec review board (5–8 slides)

We’d like those by next Wednesday (11/11) to stay on track. Also: can you confirm if you’ll accept a limited redaction for customer names in the pen test? If so, please send the redaction policy or example.

We may need a DocuSign NDAs for a small set of documents — procurement will advise.

Appreciate it —
Samantha
Samantha Yoo
Vendor Ops Lead, Brightwell Health
Samantha.Yoo@brightwellhealth.com
procure@brightwellhealth.com

Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:07:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: final artifacts and delivery schedule

Hi Samantha —

Thanks for the clear list. We can provide everything you requested. High-level plan:

1) SOC 2 Type II report: latest opinion is available as a redacted PDF. We can share a draft copy by EOD Tue (11/3) and final by 11/10.
2) Pen test summary: we will provide an executive summary with customer PII removed. We redact customer names and IPs; happy to apply additional redactions if your legal requires it.
3) ISO statements: we’ll include scope and status (we maintain ISO27001 alignment statements; certificate in progress).
4) Security deck: I’ll attach a 6-slide deck for your board review and can customize if you want more details on hosting/segmentation.

I’ve attached a draft SOC 2 excerpt and the pen test executive summary for initial review. NOTE: both are redacted; see redaction notes at the top of the PDFs.

If procurement needs a DocuSign NDA, please send the link — we typically sign a mutual NDA within 24 business hours.

Next steps: I’ll deliver the remaining artifacts (ISO statement + final deck) by COB 11/9. Does that timeline work on your side?

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Director, Customer Security
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

--

- Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2026-11-draft.pdf (pdf, redacted)

Appreciate the fast turnaround.
Samantha

Forwarding for awareness and quick action —

Marcus is coordinating final artifact delivery for Brightwell. Two things we need to confirm before the package goes out tomorrow:

1) Pen test redaction note: please add a one-paragraph explanation of redaction policy (what we redact and why). Keep it non-sensitive (no toolchain details).
2) Security deck: can we include a slide that summarizes our network segmentation + customer data isolation in plain language? Target audience: procurement + InfoSec reviewers who are not deep infra experts.

Per our plan, attached is the final artifact package for Brightwell:

- Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2026-11-draft.pdf (SOC 2 Type II redacted copy)
- pen_test_summary_2026-10.pdf (executive summary with redaction note included)
- ISO27001_statement_2026.txt (scope and status statement)
- security_deck_v3.pptx (6 slides, high-level board-friendly)

Redaction summary (also included at the top of the pen test PDF): we remove customer names, customer-specific IP addresses, and any customer-stored PII. We do not remove technical findings in abstract; all findings are described at the severity level with mitigation status. If you need additional redactions, tell us which fields and we will produce a second redacted file.

Links and administrative items:
- Drive folder (shared read-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRedwoodSIG
- DocuSign NDA: we received and countersigned (DocuSign ref ABC123) — you should see the completed envelope.
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/4432 (package uploaded to files tab)

Next steps: please confirm receipt and whether procurement / InfoSec want a short 20–30 minute walkthrough of the deck next week. Happy to schedule.

Thanks,
Marcus
